The naive re-evaluation in `makereport` broke `test_errors_in_xfail_skip_expressions` — an xfail condition error raised during *setup* gets re-raised inside `makereport`, producing an INTERNALERROR. The re-evaluation should only happen for the *call* phase (where a dynamically added marker can newly appear) and should not re-raise errors already surfaced in an earlier phase.
